name: Bahamas
about: Dec–Apr is dry season and peak. Hurricane season runs Jun–Nov, risk peaking Aug–Oct.
overview: Turquoise water close to the US East Coast, with hundreds of islands ranging from Nassau's resorts to the untouched Out Islands.
costOverview: Nassau runs expensive by Caribbean standards — even conch fritters, the islands' signature bite, cost noticeably more than equivalent street food elsewhere in the region.
